## Destination jobs

| From page | Link to | Anchor job |
|---|---|---|
| Educational / money-page | One primary collection + contact-us or phone CTA | Move from learning to a quote |
| Collection | 3–6 representative PDPs, parent buying guide, professional-installation if non-DIY | Help them pick a box |
| PDP | Compatible indoor or outdoor, line set / accessory collection, parent collection, warranty/install page | Raise AOV and keep warranty intact |
| Comparison | Both brand collections + professional-installation when DIY vs pro | Stop a wrong-category buy |
| Local | Not used for HVAC USA (ships online, no confirmed visit location) | — |
| Contractor | Freight / shipping policy, brand collections, contact-us | Fast quote |

## Anchor rules

- Prefer descriptive anchors: “Trane 3-ton heat pump systems,” “Pro-Install and Certified Start-Up,” “what ships in a freight crate.”
- One exact-match primary-keyword anchor is enough. The rest should be partial or branded.
- Ban “click here,” “learn more,” “read this” as the only anchor text.
- Do not force the primary keyword into every anchor.
- Phone number may stay visible text; it does not replace an internal link.

## Counts to brief

Match the SERP median of **in-body** internal links, then adjust:

- Short commercial page (collection / PDP intro): 3–8 in-body links
- Guide / comparison: 6–14 in-body links
- Do not brief a link dump. Every link needs a job.
